sloka: उच्यमानोऽपि भरतो मया लक्ष्मण तत्त्वत:।राज्यमस्मै प्रयच्छेति बाढमित्येव वक्ष्यति ॥ २.९७.१८॥
transliteration: ucyamāno'pi bharato mayā lakṣmaṇa tattvata:।rājyamasmai prayaccheti bāḍhamityeva vakṣyati ॥ 2.97.18॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana if I earnestly exhort Bharata to offer this kingdom to you, then on hearing those words, he would say, 'Certainly so'.
